statement: No indexed English parish-register cluster matches the colonial John's household signature - a John Gurney with a wife Mary and the English-born children Mary, Richard and John Jr. - in the target window of roughly 1620-1640, across the Gurney-surname baptisms reviewed in the FamilySearch, FindMyPast and Ancestry indexed collections. Peter and Isaac are excluded from the signature, since neither has a baptism anywhere in Britain and both were almost certainly born in New England, and Sarah is excluded as unattested. The closest clusters are the candidate parishes already weighed - Great Berkhamsted, Aylesbury, Hitcham, Eythorne, Toddington, Ackworth - each weak on the children's dates, the mother's name, or both. The absence is not evidence of any one candidate; it is the direct evidential basis for the three record-state rows, and the two-family structure of the candidate field indicates that the man's own baptism and his household's baptisms are probably not in the same searchable place.
